en: You wish to aid The Defilers in their fight against The League of Arathor in Arathi Basin?  Very well, you should ask Martin Lindsey for his assistance then.  Look for him in the Pools of Vision.
Hey Pratt - can you teach me again how to make Wild Leather Shoulders again?
Redpath!  Your life ends, here and now!
...too quiet.
What of the Alliance, Rend?
You need to be exalted with the dwarves of Ironforge before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
Good day citizen.  How may I assist you?
The magi congregate in the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter. Quite a tower they have there. Makes our barracks look like peasant hovels.
Tell me about dungeons I could explore.
Information on Frayed Abomination Stitchings.
Next, I'll place the wheel... to protect you from harm.
Who controls the Iceblood Graveyard?
You will keep all your fingers and toes, not to worry.

So you're looking to relearn what you forgot, eh? Or maybe learn what you were never taught? I know just the thing, $n. Over by Steamwheedle port, to the east, you'll find a magical book in Narain's hut called "Soothsaying for Dummies." Give it a read.$B$B<Nixx winks.>$B$BYou'll find all that you need to know and then some...
I have lost the talisman and require a new one, Al'tabim.

$C, I need more copper bars! There's a war brewing at the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj and we need supplies! The Alliance has collected $1997w and we need $1998w copper bars in total. If I don't get those copper bars, it's going to be my head on a platter!
%s stares hungrily at a Deeprun Rat.
Agghhhh! Do... not... rejoice! Your victory is a hollow one, for I shall return with powers beyond your imagining!
Greetings, $n. I am Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen, head trauma surgeon of Alliance Trauma.
%s hurls the Scepter of the Shifting Sands into the barrier, shattering it.
Thank you for your time, Lady Prestor.

I've heard that the last of the preparations are being shipped over to Silithus and should arrive in under a day. I don't want to see one of those bugs burrowing through into my mine, so I hope that someone is taking the time to assemble that Scepter of the Shifting Sands so the gong can be rung, the gates opened and the war finally begun.
You are free of His control. And while you will be judged by lesser beings, at least you have chances that the Scourge do not!
Enemy spotted! Fire!
DOOMHAMMER GUIDE MY HAND!
Thanks, Charys. C'mon Paige, sweetie.
The Scourge beckons you, foolish $r.
This bridge isn't ever going to be finished, is it?
Ya Rly! <PH>
That's what I wanted to know. Now I just need to find where the flux variance is discussed.
It's no lie, traitor. Banehollow wants your heart, and I'm going to get it for him.
Until then, I shall take my leave...
Prepare to meet your doom!
I am unworthy, $g sir:maam;.
I AM NEAR!
%s hatches!
Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?
I have given you an oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight, $n.  When you are ready and able to aid us, use it, and then we may begin.
I have no time to waste on the likes of you $c.
Wow, all of this for a love potion. Hope he's worth it.

Thanks to the combined efforts of the Alliance's adventuring guilds, we have been able to gather all of the singed corestones we think that we'll need. However, you might want to check around with the other collectors here to see if they still need help in gathering up vital resources.
The horde general is defeated!$B$BThe Alliance is the victor, and the Horde now scrambles to rebuild its weakened forces.
Holds mistletoe over $g his : her; head

It's all over 'cept for the crying now. All of the war materiel is being transported to Cenarion Hold in Silithus, and the last of it will be there in less than a day. Shouldn't be much longer until the scepter is assembled and the war finally begins.
The Stormpike Aid Station is in Dun Baldar, right outside the Dun Baldar barracks.$B$BThe Alliance currently controls it.
I am done inspecting the skulls, $n, and I am relieved.  Yenniku is not among them...

War is a bloody, messy ordeal full of pain, suffering and death. But those that survive come back with a new respect for life. Not to mention a collection of stories to tell around the bar, full of bravery and courage. So tell me $g lad : lass;, are you here to make some stories? or just to hear some of mine?
